extensions.name: Inhaltssensitives Füllen
extensions.summary: Seamlessly remove objects and heal selections using surrounding texture.
extensions.summary_de: Objekte nahtlos entfernen und Auswahlen anhand der Umgebung füllen.
extensions.description: Content-Aware Fill and Heal Selection for Clay. Select an object, run Filters → Enhance → Inhaltssensitives Füllen, and Clay reconstructs the area from nearby pixels. Also heals transparent holes.
extensions.tags: inhaltssensitives füllen content-aware fill inpaint heal selection resynthesizer remove object transparency
extensions.author: ClayDesign

extensions.name: Clay AI Agent Bridge (MCP)
extensions.summary: Let Cursor and other AI agents open images and beautify them live in Clay.
extensions.summary_de: Damit Cursor und andere KI-Agenten Bilder in Clay öffnen und live verschönern können.
extensions.description: Starts a local JSON-RPC bridge on 127.0.0.1:9877. Pair with tools/clay-mcp/server.py in Cursor MCP settings, then ask an agent to open, inspect, beautify, inpaint, and export images.
